description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5360013651946 SPRING,HELICAL,TORS: Line 0001 Qty 35 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0148 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
